title: Prime next-day deliveries delayed across multiple regions
situation: 5 customers are complaining about broken next-day delivery promises, including 1 VIP customer and a missed birthday.
hypothesis: Carrier capacity shortage in specific regions

params.reply_en: We missed our next-day delivery promise on your order. We are issuing a SAR 30 credit for the delay, and your package is on its way by Thursday.
params.reply_ar: لقد تأخرنا في تسليم طلبك في اليوم التالي. نقوم بإضافة رصيد بقيمة 30 ريالاً تعويضاً عن التأخير، وشحنتك في طريقها إليك بحلول يوم الخميس.

actions.why: Acknowledge the delayed delivery and provide immediate goodwill credit.

actions.note: Carrier capacity shortage causing next-day delivery delays for 5 customers.
